summary.name: Rasa
summary.one_liner: Rasa is an agent platform for product teams building customer-facing AI agents for text and voice channels.
use_cases: automatically test agents with simulated conversations
consolidate multiple bots into one assistant
summary.what_it_does:
Rasa lets teams create AI agents by starting with a prompt and tuning them in a UI, in code, or with a coding agent, with optional order and conditions added. It evaluates agents automatically by running simulated conversations in voice and text and reporting what passed or failed. It supports end-to-end checks, version comparison, and releasing updates to production. It also reviews conversations, tags and clusters issues, and surfaces them to the team. The page says agents can be deployed on the user's own infrastructure and that the agent codebase is version-controlled, with a visual Studio workspace, CLI, SDKs, and MCP tools for coding agents.</what_it_does>
